kultivator.momen.setting.camera.tip: Short: the camera only moves in calm moments. Full: also brief cuts during danger. Off: the camera never moves. Every key keeps working and moving ends a shot at once. Reduce Motion forces Off.
kultivator.momen.setting.letterbox.tip: Black bars at the top and bottom during a camera shot or a big title card in a safe moment. Press the Skip key twice to remove them until the scene ends.
kultivator.momen.setting.cards.tip: Calligraphy cards for new realms, ceremonies and techniques. Off: no cards, vanilla titles show as usual.
kultivator.momen.setting.music.tip: Vanilla music cues for your own moments; normal music resumes by itself afterwards. Follows the music slider.
kultivator.momen.setting.slowmo.tip: Only the Epic Moment effects slow down briefly (at most 1.5 s). The world, mobs, vanilla particles and game time never slow down.
kultivator.momen.setting.geometry.tip: Cloud vortices, lightning, light pillars, gates and giant figures are drawn as shapes. Off: everything uses lighter particles.
kultivator.momen.setting.pack.tip: While a shader pack is active, giant geometry is still drawn as soft shapes. Off: replaced by particles.
kultivator.momen.setting.sky.tip: The sky, fog, clouds and stars change colour during big moments, plus a sky layer on the screen. Weather and time never change.
kultivator.momen.setting.vfx.tip: Multiplies the size and amount of Epic Moment effects, but never beyond the performance limits.
kultivator.momen.setting.record.tip: Hides the vanilla HUD during the safe parts of your own moments, so an OBS recording looks like a cutscene. Bars and cards stay.
kultivator.momen.cmd.record.on: Record mode on: the vanilla HUD hides during the safe parts of your own moments.
kultivator.momen.cmd.pack.on: Soft shapes while a shader pack is on: enabled.
kultivator.momen.cmd.pack.off: Soft shapes while a shader pack is on: disabled, particles instead.
kultivator.momen.cmd.reset: Every Epic Moment setting is back to its default and the frame-guard memory is cleared.

kultivator.screen.help.momen.title: Epic Moments
kultivator.screen.help.momen: Epic Moments are short in-game cinematics, not video files: at tribulations, breakthroughs, the Heavens' Acknowledgement, heart demons, disciple calamities, sect ceremonies, ultimate techniques and boss kills. Cinematic camera: Short (default) only moves in calm moments; Full adds brief cuts during danger; Off never moves the camera. Every key keeps working and moving ends a shot at once. Backspace "Skip cinematic" ends a shot; press it twice to also remove the bars until the scene ends. Safety: no shot near monsters, at low health, in water or lava, while falling or riding, or during a strike's warning ring. The settings are in the Epic Moments group (camera, bars, cards, music, slow motion, giant geometry, sky, VFX scale). Record mode hides the vanilla HUD during the safe parts of your own moments: turn it on before recording a clip with OBS. Quick commands: /sinematik penuh|singkat|mati, /sinematik vfx, /sinematik rekam, /sinematik info, /sinematik reset. With a shader pack the sky darkens as a screen layer; type /sinematik paket mati if soft shapes look wrong. Nothing changes the world: no block, no weather, no time change and no real lightning. Sources: every moment has its own Source line (Against the Gods, I Shall Seal the Heavens, A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, Journey to the West, Renegade Immortal, Battle Through the Heavens and others). The camera, music, sky colours, light pillars and seal glyphs are presentation, not canon.
